integrity: The finite complex is reconstructed from definitions. The complete acyclic matching, full Hasse-orientation acyclicity, signed Morse boundary, exact rational rank, modular ranks, and a determinant-one full-rank minor are replayable from the included standard-library verifier. The full homotopy conclusion uses the Hurewicz classification of the 6-cell attachments to a wedge of 5-spheres.
scientific_limitations: The homotopy-type statement is specific to the cube graph \(Q_3\) and does not assert a formula for higher hypercubes. A terminology-adjacent 2020 directed-forest thesis was inspectable only at abstract level, so residual bibliographic overlap risk remains.
title: The Morse complex of \(Q_3\) is a mixed-dimensional sphere wedge
